errors.unavailable: runners are not available on this instance
errors.protocol: this runner speaks protocol {got}; the daemon speaks {want}. Update the runner
errors.log_too_large: a log chunk is limited to 4 MB
errors.no_output_dir: this run has no output directory on the daemon
errors.task_mixes_projects: project {project} does not run its agents on a runner: a task's projects must all run on the same runner
errors.task_mixes_runners: a task's projects must all run on the same runner
errors.task_without_runner: the task has no project on a runner
errors.engine_not_supported: this runner runs Claude Code only; {engine} needs a container

log.expire_failed: end the runs nobody answered for: {err}
log.expired: {count} runner runs ended without an answer
log.lost: runner {runner} stopped answering (or never took the run); the run is marked failed
log.read_log_failed: read the log of runner run {job}; the recorded session has none
log.write_log_failed: write the log of runner run {job}
